title: Migrate batch_jobs.cfg to a modern schedule.json with default-ABORT semantics
target_requirement: Convert the legacy nightly batch schedule to schedule.json (one {name, at, script, on_error:{policy, retries}} object per JOB line, preserving file order, integer retries) and deliver the parse_schedule(cfg_text) function that produced it, defaulting an absent ON_ERROR clause to ABORT per the sequential-chain semantics of SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §7.
expected_behavior: schedule.json contains exactly the five legacy jobs in file order with their times, scripts, and ON_ERROR policies (CONTINUE/ABORT/RETRY:2/CONTINUE/RETRY:1, retries as integers); parse_schedule skips comment and blank lines, defaults a missing ON_ERROR clause to {policy ABORT, retries 0}, and reproduces schedule.json exactly from the shipped cfg.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §7) and batch_jobs.cfg.
security_expectations: No network access; migrated.py performs no file or network I/O (text passed in); no credential material in deliverables.
failure_conditions: Reordering, inventing, dropping, or duplicating jobs; string-typed retries; defaulting an absent ON_ERROR clause to CONTINUE or RETRY (silently weakening the sequential chain); schedule.json diverging from parse_schedule of the shipped cfg.
